# Design notes (v0.1, early beta)

## Records (all generated by `src/plugin/ContractHunter.Generator`)

| EditorID | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `CHT_HunterQuest` | Quest (start game enabled) | Runs `CHT_HunterScript`: writ delivery, courier schedule, ledger menus, payouts, notoriety, standing, avengers. |
| `CHT_BountyNotice01..08`, `CHT_BountyWanted01..08`, `CHT_BountyDread01..06` | Quests | One per named outlaw, all running `CHT_BountyScript`. Aliases: 0 `ContractLocation`, 1 `MapMarker`, 2 `Target` (created at the marker, script `CHT_TargetAliasScript`), 3 `Player` (forced), 4 `Letter` (bounty letter created in the player's inventory, so its text can name the target and location), 5+ optional bodyguards. |
| `CHT_Outlaw<Tier><NN>` (22) | NPCs templated on gender-specific vanilla bandit lists (everything but name) | The named outlaws. Notice: bandit melee lists, level modifier Medium. Wanted: bandit boss lists, Hard. Dread: bandit boss lists, Very Hard, plus `CHT_AbDreadOutlaw` ("Dread Reputation", +100 Health) when they load. |
| `CHT_DreadAvenger`, `CHT_DreadAvengerArcher`, `CHT_LCharDreadAvenger` | NPCs + leveled list | Sent after a lapsed Dread warrant. |
| `CHT_Registered`, `CHT_Open<Tier>`, `CHT_OpenCount`, `CHT_BountiesClaimed`, `CHT_EscapedOutlaws` | Globals | State. |
| `CHT_Standing<Hold>` (9) | Globals | Standing with Haafingar, Reach, Hjaalmarch, Whiterun, Falkreath, Pale, Winterhold, Eastmarch, Rift. |
| `CHT_IntroMinLevel` (3), `CHT_WantedMinLevel` (10), `CHT_DreadMinLevel` (20), `CHT_PayMult` (1), `CHT_LetterIntervalDays` (2) | Globals | Tunables. |
| `CHT_HuntersWrit`, `CHT_LetterNotice/Wanted/Dread` | Books | The writ (`OnRead` script) and the three bounty letter styles. |
| `CHT_PowerLedger` + `CHT_LedgerEffect` | Lesser power + script effect | Opens the ledger. |
| `CHT_TrophySignet`, `CHT_TrophySkull` | Misc items | Trophies (vanilla gold ring and skull meshes). |

## Locations

Every location alias is inside `CompanionsRadiantAllowedHolds`, has a map marker, allows cleared locations, and reserves the location.

| Tier | Location keywords (any of) |
|---|---|
| Notice | `LocTypeBanditCamp`, `LocTypeDungeon` |
| Wanted | `LocTypeDungeon`, `LocTypeMilitaryFort` |
| Dread | `LocTypeDungeon`, `LocTypeMilitaryFort`, `LocTypeBanditCamp` |

## Flow and performance

- Before registration: a 30-second real-time poll until the writ is delivered, then a once-a-day game-time check that re-delivers a lost, unsigned writ.
- After registration: one game-time tick every 6 hours (every hour while avengers are pending) handles courier letters and avengers.
- Each bounty: `Begin()` sets a single game-time update for the deadline. The target alias script reports `OnDeath` (claim) and `OnLoad` (spawn notoriety accomplices, Dread buff). No polling loops anywhere.
- Hold detection: `Holds[i].IsChild(location)` over the nine vanilla hold locations.
- Pay: `floor(base × (1 + 0.25 × notoriety) × (1 + standing / 200) × CHT_PayMult)`, base `150 + 10L` / `350 + 15L` / `700 + 25L`.

## Scaled down from the concept (documented on purpose)

- **Posted notices**: putting notices on vanilla boards needs world edits, so letters come by courier message instead. The vanilla courier NPC (`WICourier`) is driven by Bethesda's `WICourierScript`, whose exact function signatures can't be verified without the game's script sources, so the mod doesn't call it.
- **Avenger arrival**: avengers appear at the player's position (outdoors, outside settlements) rather than walking in from a distance, because a safe off-navmesh spawn point can't be computed from Papyrus without world edits.
